newsitem.title: USA: Disney plans stake in Starwave - LATimes.
newsitem.headline: Disney plans stake in Starwave - LATimes.

text.p: Walt Disney Co has a letter of intent to acquire a minority share in Starwave Corp, the company owned by billionaire Paul Allen, the Los Angeles Times reported Friday.
The paper said Disney and Allen declined to comment, but attributed its information to an executive knowledgeable about the deal.
It said the preliminary pact calls for Disney to acquire a third of Starwave but to take over management control of the company.
The report said the deal would value Starwave at close to $300 million.
Starwave designs and runs sites on the World Wide Web, including the ESPNet-SportsZone, the paper said.
